candidates.hook: Aristocratic Woman laughs maliciously, insulting Juliana: "Home? Look at your hands, Juliana. You look like a servant."
candidates.cliffhanger: Gerald trembles in terror looking up at the imposing scarred husband who towers over him silently.
candidates.why: Opens with sharp emotional humiliation and builds up to a highly satisfying confrontation where the hero steps in to intimidate the bully.

candidates.hook: Gerald lunges forward, aggressively pointing in Juliana's face: "I have enough influence to make a beggar disappear."
candidates.cliffhanger: Gerald's arrogant bravado completely vanishes into sheer panic as the massive, scarred husband steps up to tower over him.
candidates.why: Delivers an immediate physical threat hook and fast-tracks straight to the high-stakes moment where the mysterious husband arrives.

moments.desc: Aristocratic Woman mocks Juliana's mud-caked hands, but Juliana proudly defends working with her hands.
Gerald aggressively lunges into Juliana's face, threatening to make her husband disappear.
The towering scarred husband silently confronts Gerald, causing Gerald to freeze in terror.
